title: rubus milliformis var. tenuifolius
intro: Rubus milliformis var. tenuifolius, commonly known as the Himalayan black raspberry or Himalayan raspberry, is a type of plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and protect against certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Rubus milliformis var. tenuifolius include acting as an anti-inflammatory agent, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
